notable_absence.finding: The RBAC section documents exactly which role covers which piece of cluster-level metadata (Analytics Synonyms / Eventing Metadata / FTS Aliases) but never says what role, if any, is required for the fourth thing this page's own DISCUSSION section says gets backed up in cluster scope order alongside bucket data - Global Secondary Index Definitions and View Definitions have no named RBAC role anywhere on this page.

cross_component_finding: This page's RBAC section states that ordinary bucket-level backup/restore needs only the `data_backup` role, and that cluster-level metadata needs the specific admin role for that service (analytics_admin/eventing_admin/fts_admin) - never Full Admin. This directly narrows enterprise-backup-restore.md's blanket claim, quoted in that page's own record, that 'Only Full Administrators can use cbbackupmgr'. Read together, the module contains a specific, credible, worked-example RBAC model (this page) and a much broader, unqualified single-role claim (enterprise-backup-restore.md) that the specific model contradicts.
